SELECT 
    h.locregion as location_tag,
    AVG(
        CASE WHEN i.wateraccess ILIKE 'yes%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END +
        CASE WHEN i.roadsurface ILIKE '%asphalt%' OR i.roadsurface ILIKE '%concrete%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END +
        CASE WHEN i.parkavail ILIKE 'available' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END
    ) / 3.0 as avg_rating
FROM households h
JOIN properties p ON h.housenum = p.houselink
JOIN infrastructure i ON p.infralink = i.infraref
GROUP BY h.locregion
ORDER BY h.locregion;

SELECT 
    l.regioncode as location_tag,
    AVG(
        CASE WHEN i.wateraccess ILIKE 'yes%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END +
        CASE WHEN i.roadsurface ILIKE '%asphalt%' OR i.roadsurface ILIKE '%concrete%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END +
        CASE WHEN i.parkavail ILIKE 'available' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END
    ) / 3.0 as avg_rating
FROM households h
JOIN locations l ON h.locregion = l.regioncode AND h.loczone = l.zonenum

JOIN infrastructure i ON p.infralink = i.infraref
GROUP BY l.regioncode

    (AVG(CASE WHEN i.wateraccess ILIKE 'yes%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END) +
     AVG(CASE WHEN i.roadsurface ILIKE '%asphalt%' OR i.roadsurface ILIKE '%concrete%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END) +

FROM properties p
JOIN infrastructure i ON p.infralink = i.infraref;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(
    CASE WHEN i.wateraccess ILIKE 'yes%' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END +
    CASE WHEN i.roadsurface ILIKE '%asphalt%' OR i.roadsurface ILIKE '%concrete%' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END +
    CASE WHEN i.parkavail ILIKE 'available' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END
) / 3.0, 2) as output_value
FROM properties p
JOIN infrastructure i ON p.infralink = i.infraref;

-- Building facilities = amenities (cable status)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(
    CASE WHEN lower(trim(a.cablestatus)) IN ('available', 'avail', 'yes', 'y') THEN 4 ELSE 1 END
), 2) as output_value
FROM properties p
JOIN households h ON p.houselink = h.housenum
JOIN amenities a ON h.housenum = a.houseid;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(
    0.5 * (CASE WHEN lower(trim(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')) IN ('brickwork house', 'condominium') THEN 4 ELSE 1 END) +
    0.5 * ((
        CASE WHEN i.wateraccess ILIKE 'yes%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END +
        CASE WHEN i.roadsurface ILIKE '%asphalt%' OR i.roadsurface ILIKE '%concrete%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END +
        CASE WHEN i.parkavail ILIKE 'available' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END
    ) / 3.0)
), 2) as output_value
FROM properties p
JOIN infrastructure i ON p.infralink = i.infraref;
